The '''Boz Pity Salient''' was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located within the [[Kreetan Narrows]],<ref name="LoNH" /> a region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that was part of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

[[File:Boz_Pity_Salient.jpg|thumb|left|225px|[[Nar Kreeta]] was located near the tip of the Boz Pity Salient of the [[Kreetan Narrows]]]]
This region was named after the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]], which was located in the [[Halla sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The planet [[Nar Kreeta]], which was located in Hutt Space, sat near the tip of the Boz Pity Salient of the Kreetan Narrows.<ref name="LoNH" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the end of the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Annexation of the northern Hutt territories|seized]] the Kreetan Narrows, including the Boz Pity Salient, in the pursuit of [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]].<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="LoNH" />

The Boz Pity Salient was later incorporated into the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />
